key: nvidia|senior product manager digital twin automation and robotics
title: Senior Product Manager, Digital Twin Automation and Robotics
jd_excerpt:
NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead strategic development of libraries, frameworks and skills in the Omniverse Digital Twin team focused on industrial simulation and robotic automation. We need a high-impact product leader to drive the next generation of Physical AI-enabled simulation, planning, and autonomy. These critical capabilities will helping global industrial ISVs and customers design, simulate and operate autonomous factories and warehouses.
 What You’ll Be Doing: 
 Lead the product strategy and execution for NVIDIA’s Omniverse libraries focused on Digital Twin simulations of robotics and automation systems. You will drive cross-functional alignment and deliver capabilities that enable scalable, Physical AI-powered simulation 
 Define and manage roadmap, use cases, and user journeys for industrial digital twins
 Translate customer needs into clear, prioritized requirements
 Partner with engineering teams to drive execution and technical trade-offs
 Serve as a voice of the developer across development and GTM teams
 Mentor and guide junior PMs to grow product leadership capacity
 Develop strategic roadmaps with quarterly milestones to achieve a long-term vision
 What We Need To See: 
 8+ years in product management, including experience owning sophisticated software libraries or developer-facing platforms
 BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
 Proven track record of navigating cross-functional leadership and high-stakes decision-making
Concrete examples of ability to lead product initiatives and drive alignment to deliver impactful market value
 Background in robotics, automation, simulation, manufacturing and / or digital twins.
 Examples of validated experience as a strategic and systems thinker, equally comfortable defining big-picture vision and execution details.
 Experience in both startup and large enterprise settings; adaptable, pragmatic, and process-aware.
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd: 
 Strong sense of agency, purpose and ownership, with an ability to prioritize, deliver product, and encourage those around you.
 Humble, collaborative, and curious, always seeking new ways to tackle problems and empower your team.
For over 30 years, NVIDIA has pioneered breakthroughs in AI, graphics, and accelerated computing. At NVIDIA, you will be part of a team redefining the future of intelligent machines and digital worlds. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most hard-working and dedicated people on the planet working for us and, due to outstanding growth, we are growing fast. If you're creative and with a passion for technology, we want to hear from you.
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
157,500 USD – 312,000 USD for Level 4; and 195,000 USD – 377,000 USD for Level 5. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . 
 Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 29, 2026. 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 
 NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
